notes: Single-token answers. Options are listed as 'A. <class>' / 'B. <class>'; order A puts order_a[0] at A. Intros do not name the classes. Definitions are the v3 paraphrases unchanged. No paraphrase mentions location or gives a rule for uncertain cases.

paraphrases.intro: You code demonstration events for a conflict-event dataset. Read the event description and decide which of the two event types below it is.

definitions.Protest: Protest: a public demonstration in which participants remain nonviolent, including demonstrations that face intervention or violence from others.
definitions.Riot: Riot: a demonstration in which participants engage in violence or destruction, such as attacking people or damaging property.

paraphrases.answer: Answer with one letter: A or B.

paraphrases.intro: You are an analyst labeling demonstration events for a dataset on political unrest. Classify the event described below as one of the two event types listed.

definitions.Protest: Protest: a demonstration whose participants do not use violence, even if others use force against them.
definitions.Riot: Riot: a demonstration whose participants use violence or cause destruction, for example by attacking people or damaging property.

paraphrases.answer: Respond with a single letter, A or B.

paraphrases.intro: Your job is to categorize reports of public demonstrations for a research database. Decide which of the two categories below the reported event belongs to.

definitions.Protest: Protest: participants stay nonviolent, including events where others act violently toward them.
definitions.Riot: Riot: participants commit violent or destructive acts, such as hurting people or breaking property.

paraphrases.answer: Reply with only the letter of the category: A or B.

paraphrases.intro: Below is a short report of a demonstration. Assign it to one of the two event types used in conflict monitoring that are listed below.

definitions.Protest: Protest: a public gathering in which the participants act without violence, including gatherings that are met with violence by others.
definitions.Riot: Riot: a gathering in which the participants act violently or destructively, such as assaulting people or wrecking property.

paraphrases.answer: Give your answer as one letter: A or B.

paraphrases.intro: You code violent events for a conflict-event dataset. Read the event description and decide which of the two event types below it is.

definitions.Battle: Battle: a violent clash between organized armed groups that are capable of harming each other.
definitions.Violence against civilians: Violence against civilians: an organized armed group deliberately attacks unarmed civilians who cannot defend themselves.

paraphrases.answer: Answer with one letter: A or B.

paraphrases.intro: You are an analyst labeling violent events for a dataset on armed conflict. Classify the event described below as one of the two event types listed.

definitions.Battle: Battle: organized armed groups fight each other, and each side is able to inflict harm on the other.
definitions.Violence against civilians: Violence against civilians: an organized armed group intentionally targets unarmed civilians who have no means of defending themselves.

paraphrases.answer: Respond with a single letter, A or B.

paraphrases.intro: Your job is to categorize reports of violent incidents for a research database. Decide which of the two categories below the reported event belongs to.

definitions.Battle: Battle: an armed confrontation between organized groups that can both use force against each other.
definitions.Violence against civilians: Violence against civilians: organized armed actors deliberately use force against civilians who are unarmed and defenseless.

paraphrases.answer: Reply with only the letter of the category: A or B.

paraphrases.intro: Below is a short report of a violent incident. Assign it to one of the two event types used in conflict monitoring that are listed below.

definitions.Battle: Battle: a fight between organized armed sides, each capable of hurting the other.
definitions.Violence against civilians: Violence against civilians: an organized armed group purposely harms unarmed civilians who are unable to protect themselves.

paraphrases.answer: Give your answer as one letter: A or B.
